annotations.title: Get a link to receive new jobs for this search, daily

description: Returns a link for the person. They open it on veritahire.com, enter their own email address and confirm; after that they get a daily email of new jobs matching this search (still live on employers' own careers sites). This tool sends no email and takes no email address: VeritaHire only emails the address the person types there.
